Sections.title: General Map and Report Review
Sections.subtitle: Florida baseline; apply data-related items to the work performed.

items.title: Purpose and Scope
items.statement: Identify the product type and intended purpose.

items.title: Horizontal Control and Accuracy
items.statement: State the horizontal datum and control; retain independent accuracy checks and methods.

items.title: Vertical Control and Accuracy
items.statement: For elevation data, state datum and control and document accuracy and verification methods.

items.title: Assumed Datum Control
items.statement: If using an assumed datum, distinguish it from published datums and provide reproducible control.

items.title: Dated Supporting Records
items.statement: Retain dated measurements and computations supporting the product.

items.title: Responsible Surveyor and Business
items.statement: Show responsible surveyor name/license and issuing business name, authorization number, and street/mailing addresses.

items.title: Acquisition and Revision Dates
items.statement: Identify the last acquisition date and subsequent graphic revision dates.

items.title: Signature and Seal Statement
items.statement: Include the required original-signature/seal validity statement unless electronically signed and sealed.

items.title: Map Orientation and Legend
items.statement: Show north, scale, defined survey abbreviations, and the bearing reference to an established monumented line.

items.title: Mapped Feature Responsibility
items.statement: Identify responsibility for mapped features and integration of others' work.

items.title: Final Delivery Review
items.statement: Confirm signed/sealed deliverables, sheet references, filenames, revision consistency, and contracted formats before release.

items.title: Delineation Source and Date
items.statement: Identify the delineator, organization, delineation date, supplied map, and flag sequence being surveyed.

items.title: Wetland Survey Scope
items.statement: State that work locates supplied delineation; distinguish it from performing a delineation or determining agency jurisdiction.

items.title: Flag Identification and Location
items.statement: Match surveyed flag IDs and coordinates to field tags and supplied records.

items.title: Flag Sequence and Gaps
items.statement: Resolve missing, damaged, duplicate, or out-of-sequence flags with the delineator; document unresolved gaps.

items.title: Limits Between Flags
items.statement: Confirm connections and endpoints with supplied delineation information; distinguish surveyed points from connecting or inferred lines.

items.title: Field Changes
items.statement: Record replaced flags, changes requested by the delineator, observation dates, and revision history.

items.title: Wetland Line Attribution
items.statement: Identify who established each mapped limit, and distinguish different delineations or dates on the map.

items.title: Buffers and Setbacks
items.statement: Identify the source and method for any depicted buffer or setback; distinguish it from the delineated wetland boundary.

items.title: Agency and Local Criteria
items.statement: Confirm applicable agency/local submission requirements and whether a determination or approval must accompany the survey.

items.title: Supporting Delineation Documents
items.statement: Reconcile flag logs, delineator correspondence, supplied reports, and any agency determination with the mapped line.

items.title: Approval Status and Limitations
items.statement: Describe known approval status, incomplete flag coverage, and supplied-data limitations without implying surveying flags establishes regulatory approval.

items.title: Wetland Deliverable Agreement
items.statement: Confirm map, CAD, coordinate list, and flag identifiers describe the same revision and limits.
